name: Kudou Maki
source:
A frivolous and uncontrollable Modern Japanese language teacher. She is liked by her students, but makes enemies with the other teachers.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20180603050918fw_/http://assemblage.co.jp/asm/software/12tchr/t02_maki.htm]official website[/url]]
